title: Attempting stationarity of the completed xi ledger under the support flow
question: can the actual completed xi zero ledger be proved stationary under eta(t)=exp(-t)eta?

verdict.conclusion: For any positive flow time, stationarity of every finite-height completed xi ledger is equivalent to RH. Functional reflection, reality, order, and central normalization are all preserved by an explicit off-line quartet factor whose support flow is nonstationary. The convergent horizontal residue has a strictly negative first variation for every off-line quartet. No completed-prime identity was found that sets this variation to zero.
